name: delivery-kit
description: Two plugins for long Claude Code sessions: hand the work off before the context runs out, and drive one feature from idea to reviewed pull request.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Warns before a session runs out of context, then writes a handoff document the next session resumes from in a single file read.

plugins.name: pipeline
plugins.description: Takes one feature from idea to reviewed pull request — spec, plan, build, review, ship — stopping to ask you at every step that leaves your machine.
